caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron staircase railing seen from the side, rendered in grayscale tones. The railing is composed of a vertical post on the left with decorative detailing at the top, including a finial and bulbous elements, and a broad rectangular base. The handrail slants upwards from left to right, following the incline of the staircase. The balusters are formed from ornate, symmetrical scrollwork with three circular rings evenly spaced along the incline, each intersected by straight vertical and horizontal bars. Additional curled and spiral motifs surround the rings and fill the spaces between the vertical supports, creating an intricate lattice. The drawing uses black and gray shading on a cream or off-white background to illustrate depth and metallic texture.
title: Iron Fence
